description:
MSBuild integration for Adaptify.PureView.Tool. Add this package + the
tool as a dotnet tool; Adaptify.PureView.MSBuild.targets fires before the F# compiler and
regenerates *.g.fs for every [<PureView>] binding.
releaseNotes:
- fix: a builder-attribute sink fed a LIFTED value — e.g. `Sg.VertexAttribute("Colors", colors)` where `colors` is a let-bound derived value, or any multi-argument sink with one adaptive arg — now binds the sink's `aval<_>` overload directly instead of over-lifting the whole call to an unyieldable `aval<SceneAttribute>`. The 0.1.20 consumer-pull-out (single-arg) is generalized to multi-arg sinks and `aval<'a[]>`-shaped overloads; an identity pulled-out `AVal.map` collapses to the bare cell.
- feat: a CE-item `if … then … else …` whose branches yield the SAME attributes differing only in VALUE collapses to static attributes with each differing slot hoisted to one conditional `aval` over the discriminator (a shared tuple lift for ≥2 slots) — sink-agnostic (the differ-vs-same arg split is the key/value split).
- feat: invariant — the generator NEVER emits `aval<SceneAttribute>`. When scene structure is genuinely adaptive (an attribute exists in one branch but not another, or a `match` on a lifted discriminator), it lifts the WHOLE node to `aval<ISceneNode>` (which the builder yields) — coarse (rebuilds on the discriminator change), always valid, with a warning pointing to the fine-grained static-attribute/adaptive-value helper. It refuses only when the builder has no `aval<node>` Yield at all.
- (deferred) fine-grained per-arm value-hoist for a 3+-arm `match` — those still lower, via the coarse whole-node fallback.
title: Adaptify.PureView.MSBuild
